summary_en: Solvvy Inc. approved acquisition of up to 200,000 shares (1.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥300 million via open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13, 2026 to January 31, 2027, to implement flexible capital allocation in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, Solvvy Inc.'s board of directors resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to Article 156 of the Companies Act as applied with modifications under Article 165(3). The company intends to acquire up to 200,000 common shares for a maximum total consideration of ¥300 million via open market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from November 13, 2026 through January 31, 2027.

The shares to be acquired represent up to 1.8% of outstanding shares (calculated as 200,000 divided by 11,077,334 shares outstanding as of September 30, 2026). The company stated the purpose is to implement flexible capital allocation policies in response to changes in the business environment. The disclosure notes that depending on market conditions, the company may not execute the full acquisition or any acquisition at all.
